At CaratLuck Casino, every game can be the start of a new story. Choose familiar favourites, discover something different and enjoy the moments that make you want to come back for more.

We value your curiosity and reward your activity. Find a game you love, collect Chips and unlock more opportunities with us.

Welcome Offers and Registration

Get started at our casino with a welcome offer that suits your gaming preferences. The Casino Welcome Pack combines bonus funds with free spins, the VIP Welcome Pack provides larger deposit bonuses, and the CaratLuck Crypto Welcome Pack is designed for players who prefer digital currencies.

Start playing with CaratLuck welcome bonuses. The Casino Welcome Pack includes up to 400% and 400 free spins, while the VIP Welcome Pack offers up to 500% in deposit bonuses. Each offer has its own activation conditions, minimum deposit requirements and wagering rules.

To join CaratLuck, simply create your personal account. Registration involves just a few straightforward steps:

  • Open the registration form on our website.
  • Complete the required fields with accurate personal information.
  • Verify your email address and accept the Terms and Conditions.
  • Sign in to your account, open the cashier and choose an available deposit method.

Registration is available to players aged 18 or over from countries where online gambling is permitted. Each player may create only one personal account, which must not be shared with anyone else. To claim bonuses, you must provide your personal details, verify your email address and meet the conditions of the relevant promotion.

Once your account is set up, you can deposit funds and enjoy the available bonuses. If you already play with us, just log in to CaratLuck and pick up where you left off.

Why We Are Unique

At CaratLuck, we've created a rewards system that goes beyond traditional casino bonuses. Our Chips Shop lets you exchange accumulated points not only for gaming rewards but also for real gift cards from popular brands. This means your activity can unlock gifts that aren't directly related to casino games.

In the Shop, you'll find gift cards from Amazon, Apple, Netflix, Nike and Uber. You can choose a reward that matches your interests, from digital entertainment and shopping to everyday services. Each gift has its own price in Chips, and the selection may change depending on availability.

Our rewards don't stop at gift cards. The Shop also includes bonus funds, cash rewards and free spins. You decide how to use your accumulated points, whether you'd like to redeem them straight away or save up for a more valuable gift. The advertised Chips Shop prize pool totals €300,000.

We also offer a broad choice of entertainment and payment options. Traditional banking methods are complemented by cryptocurrencies, while dedicated bonus packages let you choose the welcome offer that suits you. Our support team is available around the clock via live chat, so help with your account, payments or promotions is available 24/7.

Security Standards and Technical Reliability

We take the protection of personal information, account security and financial transaction monitoring seriously. Our security procedures include Know Your Customer (KYC) checks, transaction monitoring and measures to prevent fraud and money laundering. Identity verification helps us confirm that an account belongs to its rightful owner and that payments are made through legitimate means.

Verification may involve a two-stage document check. Depending on the circumstances, we may request:

  • A passport, national identity card or driving licence to confirm your identity.
  • A selfie holding your identification document to verify account ownership.
  • Proof of address, such as a bank statement or utility bill issued within the last three months.
  • Additional information about your payment method or source of funds if further transaction checks are required.

KYC verification is mandatory when requesting a withdrawal, when your cumulative deposits exceed €2,000 or when suspicious activity is detected. We may also request verification earlier, regardless of the amount deposited, depending on your payment method, country of residence and the nature of the transaction. We apply different levels of checks — SDD, CDD and EDD — according to the assessed risk.

Deposits exceeding €5,000 are subject to additional Source of Wealth checks. These help us confirm that funds come from legitimate sources and may involve documents relating to employment income, business activities, investments, inheritance or other sources of funds. If the information provided is insufficient, we may request further evidence before completing the verification process.

We use personal information to manage accounts, process payments, verify identities and meet applicable requirements. Technical and organisational safeguards help us protect your data, and we do not sell personal information to third parties. Certain details may, however, be shared with authorised service providers, payment partners or relevant authorities where permitted or required by our policies.

Loyalty System

Every new level in our loyalty programme brings additional opportunities. Our VIP Club includes Bronze, Silver, Gold and Platinum tiers, each divided into four levels. Obsidian is the highest status, sitting above the main ranking system. Your progress depends on the points you accumulate, with the journey beginning at Bronze I.

Members can receive level-up bonuses, daily cashback and Live Casino rakeback. As your VIP status grows, you'll gain access to additional benefits, including exclusive tournaments, promotional codes, increased withdrawal limits and priority support. Higher tiers also offer assistance from a personal VIP manager, while Obsidian status may unlock cash gifts.

Alongside the VIP Club, our Chips system rewards deposits and slot activity. Every €1 deposited earns 50 Chips, while a €1 slot wager earns 100 Chips. You can use your accumulated points in the Chips Shop to redeem available rewards.

Gaming rewards include packages of 5, 10, 20, 40 or 50 free spins. You can also choose bonus funds and cash rewards. Each item has a set price in Chips, and the availability of individual offers depends on the Shop's current selection.

You can enjoy your first VIP benefits even before moving up the ranks. We've created the VIP Welcome Pack with bonuses on your initial deposits. As you progress through our loyalty programme, further rewards become available at higher levels.

Entertainment Catalog

From classic reels to live dealer tables, our game library includes more than 12,400 titles from 106 providers. Explore our Top selection, check out the latest releases in New or browse Popular to discover games attracting attention from other players. We've also created dedicated Bonus Friendly, Jackpot and Buy Bonus categories for different gaming preferences.

In Slots, you can move from traditional fruit machines to modern video slots with additional features. Popular titles include Wanted Dead or a Wild, Mahjong Ways 2, Fortune Tiger and 3 Hot Chillies. For something different, try Golden Joker 100 Hold And Win or Luck of Panda: Bonus Combo. Slots with a Bonus Buy feature let you purchase access to bonus rounds according to the rules of each game.

Live Casino brings familiar table games to life with real dealers. Join a roulette, blackjack or baccarat table, choose a classic variation or try faster-paced formats such as Lightning Roulette, Speed Baccarat and Infinite Blackjack. Poker games are also available, with tables offering different rules, round speeds and betting limits.

For shorter gaming sessions, we've brought together a selection of games with straightforward mechanics. In crash games, the outcome depends on when you choose to cash out, while Plinko, Mines, Dice and Keno offer different ways to play. You can also explore Bingo and interactive formats that provide an alternative to traditional slots and table games.

Our Jackpot category is there for anyone interested in games with larger prize pools. You'll find Ozwin's Jackpots, Jackpot Raiders, Super Fire Jackpot and other titles featuring jackpot mechanics. We also advertise a jackpot of up to €1,000,000. The amount, type and eligibility requirements for each prize depend on the individual game or promotion.

Our library brings together games from Hacksaw Gaming, BGaming, Playson, Booongo, Iconic21 and other studios. Browse by category, theme or gameplay features to find something you enjoy. The availability of individual games may vary depending on your country and the provider's requirements.

Deposit and Withdrawal

Top up your gaming balance through the cashier using the payment methods available for your account. We support Visa, Mastercard, Interac, Skrill, Apple Pay, Google Pay and cryptocurrency payments. Supported digital currencies include Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron and Tether. Available payment options depend on your country, account currency and transaction type.

Deposits must be made using bank accounts, cards, e-wallets or other payment methods registered in your own name. Minimum and maximum deposit amounts depend on the chosen method and are displayed in the cashier. Additional fees or currency conversion may apply depending on the payment provider. Our casino's internal settlement currency is the euro.

Before withdrawing deposited funds that were not linked to a bonus, you must meet a 1x turnover requirement. If you have an active bonus, the funds associated with it are subject to the terms of that promotion. Withdrawals of bonus winnings also require you to meet the relevant conditions and complete identity verification.

To request a withdrawal, open the cashier in your account, select an available payment method and enter the amount. Under our AML rules, withdrawals must be made using the same payment method as the initial deposit. The payment method must belong to the account holder. Before processing your request, we may ask for KYC documents or additional transaction verification.

We process withdrawal requests within three working days. The time taken for funds to reach your account then depends on your bank or payment provider. Minimum and maximum withdrawal amounts vary by payment method, while daily, weekly and monthly limits are governed by separate rules. Members of higher VIP tiers may qualify for individual conditions.

Your Next Experience Starts Here

Your next gaming experience begins with a single choice. Open a favourite slot, join a live dealer table or discover something new among thousands of available games. Whenever you're ready for more, return to the Chips Shop, follow your VIP progress and unlock new rewards.

We want gaming to remain an enjoyable part of your leisure time. CaratLuck is strictly for players aged 18 or over, and anyone who needs a break can request temporary self-exclusion through our support team. During the exclusion period, access to your account, financial transactions and promotions is suspended. Play responsibly, at your own pace and for the enjoyment of the experience.

pages.content:
Claim up to 400% and 400 free spins with our Casino Welcome Pack, or choose the VIP Welcome Pack with deposit bonuses of up to 500%. CaratLuck Casino also has a dedicated cryptocurrency package with 490 free spins and additional deposit rewards.

Once your welcome offers are complete, there are eight Reload offers every week, the Early Payout sports promotion and tournaments with cash prizes to enjoy. Choose your bonus and make the most of your gaming experience!

Casino Welcome Pack

Your first five deposits give you access to the Casino Welcome Pack, offering up to 400% worth €29,000 and 400 free spins in total. We've divided the welcome package into several stages, so you can collect new rewards with your initial deposits. Each stage has its own bonus percentage, maximum bonus amount and number of free spins.

Free spins complement your deposit bonuses, allowing you to play selected slots without paying separately for each spin. Gold Rush with Johnny Cash is among the games included in the welcome offer. Bonus funds are credited to a separate balance, while access to the next stage depends on meeting the conditions of the relevant promotion.

To claim your CaratLuck Bonus, create a personal account, select the Casino Welcome Pack and make a deposit that meets the requirements of the current stage. If you're already registered, you can log in to your account and activate an available offer. Before you deposit, we'll display the bonus conditions, including the minimum deposit and maximum reward.

The Casino Welcome Pack comes with the following conditions:

  • The package is available to new players on their first five real-money deposits.
  • Bonus funds have a wagering requirement of x40 the bonus amount received.
  • Winnings from free spins are also subject to x40 wagering.
  • You have 7 days to complete wagering after activating the bonus or receiving your free spin winnings, respectively.
  • The maximum bet with an active bonus is €5.
  • Maximum winnings from free spins are capped at €1,000.
  • Withdrawals of deposit bonus winnings are limited to 10x the bonus received, while free spin winnings have a withdrawal limit of 2x the amount won.

For example, a €100 bonus with x40 wagering requires qualifying bets totalling €4,000. Once wagering is complete, the maximum withdrawal limit for winnings from that deposit bonus is €1,000. This limit does not guarantee a payout of that amount, as your actual winnings depend on the outcome of your games.

We allow only one active bonus at a time. If you request a withdrawal before completing the bonus conditions or while the bonus is still active, any unused bonus funds and associated winnings will be forfeited. You can also cancel a bonus through your account or contact our support team, but doing so will result in the loss of the bonus funds and related winnings.

Winnings from the Casino Welcome Pack become eligible for withdrawal once you've met the wagering requirements and successfully completed identity verification. All payouts are subject to our standard KYC and AML procedures.

VIP Welcome Pack

The VIP Welcome Pack gives you access to larger deposit bonuses totalling up to 500%, with a maximum combined value of €29,000. We've created this package for your first four real-money deposits. Each stage provides an additional bonus based on its specified percentage and maximum reward amount.

This offer is also known as the VIP High Roller Package. Unlike the standard Casino Welcome Pack, it focuses on deposit bonuses without additional free spins. Each of the four stages has its own minimum deposit requirement and maximum bonus amount.

You must activate your VIP bonus within seven days of it being awarded. Once activated, a separate seven-day wagering period begins. The wagering requirement is x40 the bonus amount, and the maximum permitted bet while using the bonus is €5.

The withdrawal limit depends on which of the four VIP bonuses you've activated:

VIP Bonus Maximum Withdrawal of Winnings
First deposit 3x the bonus amount
Second deposit 5x the bonus amount
Third deposit 5x the bonus amount
Fourth deposit 5x the bonus amount

For example, if your first VIP bonus is €200, the maximum withdrawal of winnings from that bonus is €600. For a bonus of the same value on the second, third or fourth stage, the limit increases to €1,000. These limits apply after you've completed wagering and do not represent guaranteed winnings.

The VIP Welcome Pack operates separately from our loyalty programme. After using your welcome offers, you can continue progressing through the Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Obsidian levels. Our VIP Club includes level-up bonuses, daily cashback, Live Casino rakeback and additional benefits for members at higher tiers.

If you cancel a VIP bonus or request a withdrawal before completing its conditions, the bonus funds and any associated winnings will be forfeited. Winnings from this package are also subject to standard KYC verification before payment.

CaratLuck Sport Bonus

Our sportsbook features Early Payout, a special promotion for football betting. It allows your bet on a team to win to be settled as a winner before the final whistle. Your selected team simply needs to take a lead of at least two goals at any point during normal time.

Early Payout applies to selected football fixtures marked with the relevant promotion label. To qualify, you must place a pre-match bet on either the home or away team to win in the main 1X2 market. Bets on a draw and bets placed after kick-off are not eligible for this promotion.

For example, suppose you back a team to win and they take a 2-0 lead during the match. We'll settle your bet as a winner under the Early Payout rules. Even if the opposition later equalises or goes on to win, the result of your already settled bet will remain unchanged.

Early Payout is available on selected matches in the Premier League, La Liga, Ligue 1, Bundesliga, Serie A and UEFA Conference League. We may update the list of eligible competitions, so a fixture only qualifies when the Early Payout label appears in our sportsbook.

If a match is postponed, cancelled or requires a result review, our general sports betting settlement rules apply. The promotion does not change how bets that fail to meet its conditions are settled. We may restrict participation or cancel the relevant promotional benefit if the rules are breached.

CaratLuck Crypto Welcome Pack

We've created a separate welcome package for cryptocurrency deposits, offering a combined bonus of up to 490% and 490 free spins. The Crypto Welcome Pack has a maximum value of 16,900 USDT. It covers the first five qualifying deposits made by new players, with additional funds and free spins awarded according to the conditions of each stage.

To activate the offer, choose a cryptocurrency payment method and make the minimum deposit required for the relevant bonus. We support Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, Tron and Tether. Available deposit methods and networks are displayed in the cashier, where you can also check the payment details before making a transfer.

Free spins are credited automatically after a qualifying deposit. Each spin has a value of €0.10, and maximum winnings from free spins are capped at €1,000. The number of free spins awarded depends on the relevant stage of the welcome package.

The Crypto Welcome Pack has an x40 wagering requirement for both deposit bonuses and free spin winnings. Bonus funds must be wagered within seven days of activation, while free spin winnings must be wagered within seven days of being credited. The maximum bet while using an active bonus is €5.

Withdrawals of winnings from a crypto deposit bonus are limited to 10x the bonus amount received. If you request a payout before completing wagering, the active bonus and any associated winnings will be forfeited. The same applies if you voluntarily cancel the bonus through your account or our support team.

Cryptocurrency rewards under our CaratLuck Bonus offers are subject to KYC and additional AML checks, which may include verification of the source of funds before payment.

After the welcome packages, we continue rewarding players with eight Reload offers every week. These provide opportunities to claim new deposit bonuses under the conditions of the current promotions. The availability of each Reload bonus depends on your account, and only one bonus offer can be active at a time.

All CaratLuck Casino Bonus welcome packages follow the same financial verification rules. You must complete KYC before withdrawing bonus winnings, while cryptocurrency transactions may require additional documents confirming the source of funds. Deposits exceeding €5,000 are subject to Source of Wealth checks. Withdrawals are made using the same payment method as the initial deposit, in accordance with our AML rules.

Jackpots

Explore CaratLuck jackpot slots with a prize pool of up to €1,000,000. Our Jackpot category brings together games with special prize mechanics, additional features and opportunities for substantial wins. Each slot has its own jackpot rules and bonus round features.

Available games include Ozwin's Jackpots, Jackpot Raiders, 777 Jackpot Diamond Hold and Win and Super Fire Jackpot. You can also try Ocean King Jackpot, Frost Queen Jackpots and Jackpot Joker. Some slots use Hold and Win mechanics, while others feature their own ways of triggering special prizes.

Jackpot amounts depend on the game, its mechanics and the provider's rules. In some slots, prizes may be fixed or change during gameplay. The advertised maximum of €1,000,000 does not guarantee a win of that amount, and certain jackpot draws may have additional minimum bet requirements.

Jackpot winnings are different from deposit bonuses. If you're playing with an active bonus balance, access to certain games and their contribution towards wagering depend on the conditions of the relevant promotion. Regular game rules apply when playing with real-money funds.

Tournaments

CaratLuck hosts tournament promotions for Playson and Booongo slots, with cash prizes available to participants. Lucky Boom has a total prize pool of €600,000, while Big Sunday Blast offers a share of €25,000 every Sunday. Both promotions have their own schedules, betting requirements and prize rules.

Lucky Boom runs from 21 September 2026 to 7 February 2027. The total prize pool is €600,000, with €30,000 allocated to each stage. Participants can receive random cash prizes while playing selected Playson and Booongo slots.

To qualify, you must complete at least 100 spins with a minimum bet of €0.50. Each qualifying spin gives you a chance to receive a random prize from the available pool. You can win multiple rewards during the promotion while prizes remain available. Unclaimed prizes expire 90 days after being awarded, and technical malfunctions affecting the outcome may result in payouts being voided.

Big Sunday Blast takes place every Sunday from 02:00 to 23:59 UTC between 7 June 2026 and 7 March 2027. The weekly prize pool is €25,000. All Playson and Booongo slots are eligible, and players must meet the minimum bet and spin requirements to qualify.

Only real-money bets count towards Big Sunday Blast. The minimum bet is €0.50, and you must complete at least 100 spins to qualify. Prizes are credited automatically or after the relevant tournament stage has ended.

pages.title: Login
pages.content:
Log in to CaratLuck Casino and pick up where you left off with your existing balance, favourite slots and active rewards. Your account keeps your personal settings and transaction history, so everything you need remains available whenever you sign in.

To log in to CaratLuck, enter the email address and password you used when registering. We protect your personal information, monitor suspicious activity and help you regain access if you encounter any difficulties.

How to Log In and Complete Verification

Signing in to your CaratLuck account takes just a few simple steps. Click the Login button in the top menu, enter your account details and return to your personal dashboard. There, you can check your balance, transaction history, active bonuses and profile settings.

To access your account, follow these steps:

  1. Click the Login button at the top of the page.

  2. Enter the email address you used during registration.

  3. Enter your account password.

  4. Click Login to complete the sign-in process.

Logging in and verifying your identity are two separate processes. Your email address and password are sufficient for a standard login, while Know Your Customer (KYC) checks help us confirm that the account belongs to you. Additional verification may be required before certain financial transactions, even if you've previously accessed your account without any issues.

Full KYC verification is mandatory when you request a withdrawal, when your cumulative deposits exceed €2,000 or if we detect suspicious activity. Depending on your payment method, country of residence and the nature of your transactions, we may request documents earlier, regardless of how much you've deposited.

To verify your identity, we may ask for:

  • A valid passport, national identity card or driving licence.

  • A selfie holding your identification document.

  • A bank statement, utility bill or other proof of address issued within the last three months.

  • Additional documents relating to your payment method or source of funds if required for verification.

For deposits exceeding €5,000, we apply Source of Wealth checks. These involve confirming the legitimate origin of your funds through documents relating to employment income, business earnings, investments or other sources of income. Additional checks may also apply to cryptocurrency transactions under our AML Policy.

During verification, we use different levels of checks, including SDD, CDD and EDD, depending on our risk assessment. If the documents provided are insufficient or the information doesn't match your account details, we may request further evidence. Certain financial features may remain restricted until the required checks are complete. Once verification is successful, we'll confirm your account's verification status.

Security Standards and Account Monitoring

We protect your account every time you log in to CaratLuck Casino through technical and organisational security measures. We monitor financial transactions and unusual activity to help prevent unauthorised access and fraud.

Suspicious login attempts, unusual transactions or inconsistencies in personal information may trigger additional security checks. In such cases, we may temporarily restrict access to certain features until we've verified the account holder's identity. If documents are required, our team will explain what information you need to provide.

To protect financial transactions, we check that payment methods match the account holder's details. Bank cards, e-wallets and other payment methods must belong to the person registered on the account. Under our AML Policy, withdrawals must be made using the same payment method used for the initial deposit.

We use your personal information to manage your account, verify your identity, process transactions and meet applicable requirements. We do not sell personal information to third parties. However, certain details may be shared with payment partners, authorised service providers or relevant authorities where permitted or required by our policies.

Use a unique password and never share it with anyone else. If you sign in on a shared device or someone else's computer, make sure you log out when you've finished. Avoid saving passwords in publicly accessible browsers, and never disclose confidential account information to other people.

If you notice unfamiliar transactions, changes to your settings or activity you don't recognise, contact our support team. We'll investigate the circumstances and, if necessary, request identity verification or temporarily restrict access to protect your information and funds.

We allow each player to create only one personal account. Creating duplicate accounts, sharing access with other people or using someone else's identification documents breaches our rules and may result in additional verification, restricted account features or account suspension.
<p>Once access has been restored, you can log in to CaratLuck Casino, check your balance and view your active rewards. Any unused <a href="/promotions/">welcome offers and bonuses</a> remain available only within the specified promotional periods and conditions. We take care of your account security and support responsible gambling for players aged 18 and over.</p>

mainEntity.name: Can I play on my phone without installing an app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Simply open our website in a mobile browser on your iOS or Android device. You can access games, manage your account, check your rewards and use the cashier without having to download a separate app.

mainEntity.name: How can I regain access to my account if I have trouble logging in?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you're unable to log in, contact our support team through live chat. In some cases, account access may be temporarily restricted due to security checks or outstanding KYC requirements.

mainEntity.name: Can I change or cancel an active bonus?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can cancel a bonus in the My Bonuses section of your account or through our support team. Cancelling a bonus forfeits the bonus balance and any winnings associated with it. Only one bonus can be active at a time.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I don't use my account for over a year?

acceptedAnswer.text: After 12 consecutive months of inactivity, your account may be classified as Dormant. If funds remain in the account, a monthly administration fee of €10 may apply. Charges stop once the account becomes active again or the remaining balance has been exhausted.

mainEntity.name: Can I create multiple accounts to claim different bonuses?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. We allow only one personal account per player. Creating duplicate accounts to take part in promotions breaches our rules and may result in bonus cancellation, forfeiture of winnings and account suspension.

mainEntity.name: How can I take a temporary break from playing?

acceptedAnswer.text: To request self-exclusion, contact our support team and follow the instructions provided. Once the restriction takes effect, you won't be able to access your account, make financial transactions or receive promotional offers for the specified period.
